sloka: गत्वाश्रमपदं तत्र विचचार सुनिर्भया ।न सापश्यत्स्थिता तत्र काञ्चिदभ्यागतां सखीम् ।। ७.२.१५ ॥
transliteration: gatvāśramapadaṁ tatra vicacāra sunirbhayā ।na sāpaśyatsthitā tatra kāñcidabhyāgatāṁ sakhīm ।। 7.2.15 ॥

translations.english: Having gone to the hermitage, she wandered there very fearlessly, but she did not see any friend present or arrived there.
